items.label: Compatible with
items.value: Headlight assembly is specifically designed compatible with Tucson SEL models from 2022 to 2023, ensuring a perfect match for both, please confirm your vehicle model and year before purchasing to avoid any compatibility issues

items.label: Replacement Part Number
items.value: Headlight assembly is a direct replacement for the part, it replaces numbers left 92101-CW150 20-17910-00 HY2502250, exact fit for seamless integration

items.label: Extraordinary Quality
items.value: Headlight constructed from premium quality polycarbonate and ABS plastic, this headlight assembly is IP67 designed to withstand harsh outdoor conditions, its long lasting build performance even in heavy weather situations

items.label: Appearance Design
items.value: Headlight crafted from premium plastic with meticulous artistry, this design masterfully blends sleek curved surfaces with crisp angular lines, the outer side of the lampshade features subtly raised curves that amplify its three-dimensional presence, creates a compelling visual contrast

items.label: Simple Installation
items.value: Headlight featuring a plug-n-play design, this front headlight assembly allows for straightforward installation with direct bolt-on fitment, no drilling or modifications are needed, although professional installation is recommended for optimal results
